label: first copy step (re-input of token 0) in short sequences starting with z or 1
explanation: Sparse feature (0.035% of steps). About 61% of activation mass is at the first copy step (recall_idx 1, the step after <DEL> where the model re-inputs orig(0)), and it is strongly gated by short length (L=3,4) and by the first token being z (12x lift) or 1 (8x lift). The strongest activations are L=3 sequences beginning with z whose second token is 1/v/p/k. The remaining ~30% of mass is weak firing late in the original phase (t=3-5, often on input z or a digit) and some later copy steps. Magnitude is highest for L=3 with first token z and falls with longer L. It almost never fires at t<3, and even within the core context precision is low: many z-initial short sequences do not fire, depending on the other tokens in ways a simple predicate does not capture. Test F1 is about 0.2.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by phase (copy phase: z, 1, p, c; input phase: r, 0, j, n; delimiter step: ) and the token being output, by phase (delimiter step: 1, z, k, p; copy phase: 1, v, k, p; input phase: ); timing cues that raise it most: t=4, L=3 & t=4, t=5.
